title: Value for money and equipment worth
summary: Reviews on value focus mainly on whether the F70's equipment, specification, design, and driving experience feel worth the price, with clear praise outweighing explicit criticism in the labeled examples.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car offers good value through strong equipment levels, specification, build quality, design, and an enjoyable drive for the money.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the car can feel not worth the money, and one example concerns a dealer interaction framed as taking customers' money rather than vehicle value itself.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention value or worth wording but often lack enough context to tell whether the reviewer is praising or criticizing the price proposition.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short, so value judgments are sometimes too context-light to classify beyond undetermined.
One negative example is about dealer behavior and money rather than the vehicle's own value, so the topic cluster mixes product value with purchase experience.
The examples are sentiment-stratified samples and do not support broader claims about overall market value perception.
